content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Roorkee Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Senior Research Fellow: First class B. Tech and 1st class M. Tech. with specialization in welding/production/mechanical/manufacturing/metallurgical engineering. GATE qualified candidates will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: Rs. 42000 Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee), a premier government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Senior Research Fellow, offering a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow post at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview, where candidates need to report directly to the venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow post is scheduled for 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Senior Research Fellow at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First class B. Tech and 1st class M. Tech. with specialization in welding/production/mechanical/manufacturing/metallurgical engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 42000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this IIT Roorkee recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Roorkee will be based solely on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Research Fellow position will be in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, specifically at IIT Roorkee.
